regions.overview: The Ruins is dominated by Unholy skeletons. Backline stress and ranged attackers are usually more urgent than the durable but low-pressure frontline defenders.

commonThreats.description: Bone Courtiers and shared stress dealers can create lasting expedition risk from the back ranks.
Bone Arbalists attack from safety and become more dangerous when attacking marked heroes.
counters: Pull the Arbalist into a weak forward attack pattern

commonThreats.description: Bone Defenders and later Bone Captains can absorb direct damage while more urgent enemies act behind them.
counters: Attack or disable the backline first

commonThreats.description: Veteran and Champion enemies add party-wide attacks, stuns, movement, buffs, and corpse revival.

resistanceTendencies.note: Ruins-specific skeletons are effectively unsuitable bleed targets.
Skeletons are generally vulnerable to blight, though resistance rises with expedition difficulty.
Backline skeletons begin vulnerable to stun, while large and higher-tier enemies resist it more strongly.
Courtier and Arbalist can be disrupted by movement, while Defender, Captain, and Bearer are less practical move targets.

recommendedCapabilities: Clear corpses before Bone Bearer revival
cautions: Do not build the party's primary damage plan around bleed.
Do not spend early turns grinding through a Bone Defender while a Courtier or Arbalist remains active.
Champion expeditions require an immediate plan for Bone Bearer and its corpse revival.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Ruins
Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Enemy types

regions.overview: The Warrens is dominated by Human and Beast Swinefolk. Fast backline enemies spread stress, disease, marks, and party disruption while tougher frontliners exploit the resulting openings.

commonThreats.description: Swine Wretches attack quickly from the back ranks, inflicting stress and potentially a random disease on any hero.
Swine Drummers mark heroes and reduce dodge, enabling dangerous follow-up attacks from other Warrens enemies.
Choppers, Swinetaurs, and Skivers can stun, knock heroes back, or pressure multiple party positions at once.
counters: Control high-impact enemies before they act

commonThreats.description: Champion Warrens expeditions add the Swine Skiver, whose backline attacks combine heavy damage with stun, movement, blight, and debuffs.
counters: Pull or shuffle the Skiver forward

resistanceTendencies.note: Warrens enemies are generally more practical bleed targets than blight targets, though individual and higher-tier resistances still vary.
Swinefolk commonly resist blight, with resistance increasing at higher expedition difficulties.
Small backline enemies are often controllable, while large enemies and Champion variants resist stun more strongly.
Movement is especially valuable against Swinetaur and Swine Skiver, but reliability falls against larger or higher-tier targets.

recommendedCapabilities: Clear marks or protect marked heroes
cautions: Do not build the party's primary damage-over-time plan around blight without checking individual resistance.
Do not let a Swine Wretch or Drummer act repeatedly while attacking a low-pressure frontline enemy.
Veteran and Champion expeditions require a plan for large enemies and disruptive party-wide attacks.
Champion expeditions require immediate control or displacement of the Swine Skiver.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Warrens
Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Enemy types

regions.overview: The Weald combines fast swarming enemies, durable fungal frontliners, dangerous mark synergies, and large high-damage threats. Backline support enemies often make otherwise manageable frontliners lethal.

commonThreats.description: Fungal Artillery and Crones mark and debuff heroes so Fungal Scratchers can use their stronger marked-target attack.
counters: Kill or control the marker first
Move a marked frontline hero out of reach

commonThreats.description: Gnashers inflict bleed and disease while fungal enemies and Giants apply blight, creating simultaneous damage-over-time pressure.
counters: Bring both bleed and blight cures
Prevent fast enemies from acting repeatedly

commonThreats.description: Ectoplasms can multiply or merge when other Ectoplasms and their corpses remain available, prolonging the battle.
counters: Focus Ectoplasms one at a time
Use attacks that leave no corpse

commonThreats.description: Unclean Giants combine extreme frontline burst with party shuffle and blight, while resisting many direct control effects.

resistanceTendencies.note: Bleed is the region's most consistent damage-over-time option and bypasses fungal protection.
Fungal and other Weald enemies commonly resist blight, especially at higher difficulty.
Small enemies vary, but the Unclean Giant is notably more practical to weaken than to move.
Moving fungal frontliners can disable their main attacks, while large enemies strongly resist movement.

recommendedCapabilities: Reach and control enemy positions 3 and 4
Clear marks or protect marked heroes
Clear corpses before enemy summon effects
Remain functional after a party shuffle
cautions: Do not rely on blight as the party's primary damage-over-time plan without checking individual resistance.
Do not attack a protected Fungal Scratcher first while its marker remains active.
Ectoplasm fights can expand if targets and corpses are left unmanaged.
Champion expeditions require immediate answers to Hateful Virago's healing denial.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Weald
Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Enemy types

regions.overview: The Cove combines high direct damage, backline stress and support, guard, stuns, and heavily protected enemies. Most Pelagic enemies resist bleed but are vulnerable to blight.

commonThreats.description: A Drowned Thrall explodes on its second action, dealing severe health and stress damage to the entire party.
counters: Stun it to delay the sequence

commonThreats.description: Pelagic Groupers deliver high direct damage while Shamans apply stress, buffs, and healing, forcing priorities to follow the party's current risk.
counters: Prioritize Groupers when health is low
Prioritize Shamans when stress is high
Control whichever threat cannot be killed first

commonThreats.description: Pelagic Guardians protect dangerous allies, while Sea Maggots and Uca enemies make direct attacks inefficient through high protection.
Deep Stingers and Uca enemies combine stun, bleed vulnerability, severe bleeding, and party-position disruption.

resistanceTendencies.note: Pelagic scales and several drowned enemies make bleed an unreliable primary plan.
Blight is broadly effective and bypasses the protection common among Cove enemies.
Basic Pelagics can be vulnerable, while Stingers, Thralls, large enemies, and Champion threats resist stun more strongly.
Pulling a Shaman forward is valuable, but large enemies and higher-tier variants are harder to displace.

recommendedCapabilities: Break guard or stun the guarding enemy
Reach and control the enemy backline
Resist stun and recover party positions
cautions: Do not allow a Drowned Thrall to take its second action.
Do not build the party's primary damage-over-time plan around bleed.
A Guardian protecting a Thrall can turn an otherwise simple priority target into an emergency.
Veteran and Champion expeditions require an answer to Uca Major's severe bleed and knockback.
Champion expeditions require fast control of Squiffy Ghast's party-wide stress and horror.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Cove
Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Status effects

priorityReasons: Deals straightforward health damage with broader reach than many basic frontliners.
Usually presents less lasting risk than active backline stress or ranged enemies.

dangerousActions.name: Graveyard Slash
dangerousActions.description: A direct melee attack that can reach beyond the frontmost hero.
counters: Move it to the backmost position

effectiveResponses: Remove it after more urgent backline threats unless immediate health damage is the greater concern.
Use blight or Unholy bonuses when convenient.
cautions: At higher difficulties it may begin stealthed, delaying direct targeting without destealth.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Bone Soldier

priorityReasons: Tempting Goblet inflicts stress that persists beyond the current fight.
High speed often lets it act before slower heroes.
traits: Low early move and stun resistance

dangerousActions.name: Tempting Goblet
dangerousActions.description: Attacks any hero from the back ranks, inflicting substantial stress and later a critical-chance debuff.
counters: Pull or shuffle it to enemy position 1

effectiveResponses: Prioritize it when expedition stress is a concern.
Pulling it to the front forces a much weaker attack pattern.
cautions: Enemy position 2 may still allow Tempting Goblet, so a partial pull is not a complete shutdown.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Bone Courtier

priorityReasons: Quarrel delivers strong backline health damage with meaningful critical potential.
It preferentially threatens marked heroes.

dangerousActions.name: Quarrel
dangerousActions.description: A strong ranged attack against the party backline that is more dangerous to marked heroes.
counters: Pull it into the front two positions

effectiveResponses: Disable or kill it before it repeatedly pressures fragile backliners.
A successful pull replaces Quarrel with its weaker Bayonet Jab until it retreats.
cautions: Bayonet Jab moves it backward, so movement disruption may need to be repeated.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Bone Arbalist

priorityReasons: Its protection makes direct attacks inefficient.
Its damage pressure is usually lower than the enemies it accompanies.

dangerousActions.name: Dead Weight
dangerousActions.description: Hits a front hero and can stun and knock the target backward.

effectiveResponses: Leave it until urgent backline enemies are controlled.
Use blight or armor piercing instead of inefficient direct damage.
cautions: Dead Weight can still disrupt a position-dependent frontline even when the Defender is left for last.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Bone Defender

priorityReasons: Its attacks have broad reach and high critical potential.
Impale damages the entire party while it remains in the front.

dangerousActions.name: Spear Thrust
dangerousActions.description: A strong attack that can reach any hero and knock the target backward.

dangerousActions.name: Impale
dangerousActions.description: A party-wide attack available while the Spearman occupies the enemy front.
counters: Push it out of the front two positions

effectiveResponses: Prioritize it before low-pressure defenders.
Stun it or push it backward to prevent Impale.
cautions: Spear Thrust remains usable from any enemy position, so pushing it back only removes Impale.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Bone Spearman

priorityReasons: Ground Pound can stun the entire party.
Crushing Blow combines high frontline damage with reduced stun resistance.

dangerousActions.name: Crushing Blow
dangerousActions.description: Heavy frontline damage that reduces the target's stun resistance.

dangerousActions.name: Ground Pound
dangerousActions.description: A party-wide attack that can stun multiple heroes.

effectiveResponses: Use blight, armor piercing, or protection reduction.
Damage reduction is useful when its high resistances make direct control unreliable.
cautions: Do not assume a stun or move attempt will reliably disable this large enemy.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Bone Captain

priorityReasons: Passively increases allied damage and can add further offensive buffs.
Unholy Rally revives corpses at full health as an automatic action.

dangerousActions.name: Wicked Surge
dangerousActions.description: Improves another enemy's accuracy and damage.

dangerousActions.name: Unholy Rally
dangerousActions.description: Automatically revives an available enemy corpse at full health.
counters: Use attacks that leave no corpse
Kill the Bearer before more enemies die

effectiveResponses: Treat it as an immediate Champion-tier priority.
Use corpse clearing while working through enemies that screen it.
cautions: Repeated stun attempts are not a dependable plan because its stun resistance is exceptionally high.
Ignoring corpses allows defeated enemies to return at full health.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Bone Bearer

priorityReasons: Its durable frontline presence delivers bleed and disruptive stun or knockback.
Fragile Warrens support enemies usually create greater lasting risk and should often be removed first.

dangerousActions.name: Butcher Cut
dangerousActions.description: A frontline attack that causes bleed and at higher difficulty reduces healing received.

dangerousActions.name: Ball and Chain
dangerousActions.description: Targets the party backline and can stun and knock the victim backward.

effectiveResponses: Control it while eliminating Wretches, Drummers, or Skivers behind it.
Exploit its relatively low bleed resistance instead of relying on movement.
cautions: Leaving it for later is not harmless when bleed or party displacement threatens an already weakened hero.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Swine Chopper

priorityReasons: Hook Where It Hurts reaches the first three heroes from any enemy position and has high critical potential.
Later variants reduce bleed and disease resistance, amplifying other Warrens threats.
traits: Stealth at Veteran and Champion difficulty

dangerousActions.name: Hook Where It Hurts
dangerousActions.description: A high-critical attack that later reduces bleed and disease resistance; the Slasher moves itself backward after attacking.

effectiveResponses: Remove it early when its resistance debuff would expose the party to disease or bleed follow-ups.
Use attacks that bypass protection and can reach it after it retreats.
cautions: Pulling it forward does not disable its attack because Hook Where It Hurts is usable from every enemy position.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Swine Slasher

priorityReasons: Vomit inflicts persistent expedition costs through stress and random disease.
High speed and access to every hero let it create risk before slower parties can respond.

dangerousActions.name: Vomit
dangerousActions.description: Targets any hero for stress and a chance of random disease, adding a dodge debuff at higher difficulty.

effectiveResponses: Prioritize it when expedition stress or disease would be costly.
Use its low health and early control resistances to prevent repeated Vomit attacks.
cautions: Its speed means a slow party may still suffer one Vomit before removing it.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Swine Wretch

priorityReasons: Drum of Doom inflicts stress across the party.
Its mark and dodge debuff enable stronger follow-up attacks from other Warrens enemies.

dangerousActions.name: Drum of Doom
dangerousActions.description: Inflicts stress on the entire party from the enemy backline.

dangerousActions.name: Drum of Debilitation
dangerousActions.description: Marks one hero and reduces dodge, setting up allied attacks.

effectiveResponses: Treat it as an early target because both actions increase expedition-level risk.
Pulling or shuffling it away from the back ranks restricts its support pattern.
cautions: Judge its priority together with enemies that exploit marked targets; the combination is more dangerous than either enemy alone.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Swine Drummer

priorityReasons: From the back ranks it can use a party-wide attack or a powerful charge with stun and knockback.
Its large health pool and protection make an unfocused damage race inefficient.

dangerousActions.name: Pig Spear
dangerousActions.description: A party-wide ranged attack used from the rear enemy positions.

dangerousActions.name: Boar Rush
dangerousActions.description: A powerful charge from the rear that can stun and knock a hero backward while moving the Swinetaur forward.

effectiveResponses: Eliminate its allies and their corpses so its size traps it in enemy position 1.
In the front it is restricted to the weaker Crunching Backhand before using Trot Retreat to reposition.
cautions: Direct movement and stun attempts can be unreliable because of its high resistances.
Leaving corpses or another enemy in front gives it room to regain its dangerous rear-position pattern.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Swinetaur

priorityReasons: Spit to Roast combines heavy damage, stun, and knockback and preferentially threatens marked heroes.
Cripple Them attacks three heroes while applying blight and combat debuffs.

dangerousActions.name: Spit to Roast
dangerousActions.description: A severe single-target attack from the rear that stuns and knocks the victim backward, with increased danger to marked heroes.
counters: Pull the Skiver to enemy position 1

dangerousActions.name: Cripple Them
dangerousActions.description: Attacks party positions 2 through 4 together, applying blight and reducing dodge and speed.
counters: Pull the Skiver to enemy position 1

effectiveResponses: Treat it as an immediate Champion-tier priority.
Pull or shuffle it into enemy position 1, where it must use the weaker Goring Flight to move backward.
cautions: Goring Flight restores its access to dangerous backline attacks, so displacement may need to be repeated.
A marked hero makes Spit to Roast especially urgent.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Swine Skiver

priorityReasons: Cytokinesis can create another Ectoplasm and extend the fight.
Multiple Ectoplasms or their corpses enable them to merge into a more durable Large Ectoplasm.

dangerousActions.name: Cytokinesis
dangerousActions.description: Creates another Ectoplasm when space is available, expanding the enemy action economy.

dangerousActions.name: Ectoplasmic Profusion
dangerousActions.description: Combines available Ectoplasms or Ectoplasm corpses into a Large Ectoplasm.
counters: Kill one target at a time
Use attacks that leave no corpse

effectiveResponses: Prevent the encounter from growing before spending turns on lower-priority enemies.
Remove corpses immediately when another Ectoplasm can exploit them.
cautions: Splitting damage between several Ectoplasms gives their multiplication mechanics more time to act.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Ectoplasm

priorityReasons: It can create additional Ectoplasms and restart the multiplication cycle.
Its large health pool and protection make inefficient direct damage costly.

dangerousActions.name: Cytokinesis
dangerousActions.description: Creates a small Ectoplasm in an available enemy position.

dangerousActions.name: Slimesmack
dangerousActions.description: A direct attack that can stun its target.

effectiveResponses: Use bleed, armor piercing, or protection reduction rather than inefficient raw damage.
Do not allow newly spawned Ectoplasms to multiply unchecked.
cautions: Its strong resistances make repeated stun or movement attempts unreliable.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Large Ectoplasm

priorityReasons: High speed lets packs apply bleed before many heroes can respond.
Rabid Rush can spread disease and its high critical chance adds party stress.

dangerousActions.name: Rabid Rush
dangerousActions.description: A fast pounce that inflicts bleed, may spread Rabies, and moves the Gnasher forward; critical hits also stress the party.

effectiveResponses: Kill the next Gnasher likely to act instead of spreading damage across the pack.
Use accuracy support to overcome their dodge.
cautions: A missed attack can leave several fast Gnashers free to stack bleed in the same round.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Rabid Gnasher

priorityReasons: High protection makes it slow to remove with direct damage.
Its ordinary attacks are inaccurate, but Rend the Marked becomes dangerous when allied support marks a frontline hero.

dangerousActions.name: Rend the Marked
dangerousActions.description: Deals substantially increased damage to a marked hero in the first two party positions.
counters: Move the marked hero out of the front

dangerousActions.name: Groping Swipe
dangerousActions.description: An inaccurate frontline attack that adds blight at Veteran and Champion difficulty.

effectiveResponses: Remove the Fungal Artillery or Crone enabling it before grinding through its protection.
Use bleed or armor piercing, or move it to the back where it is restricted to Harmless Swipe.
cautions: Its priority rises sharply while a vulnerable frontline hero is marked.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Fungal Scratcher

priorityReasons: Mark Prey enables Fungal Scratchers to deal increased damage to frontline heroes.
Rain of Blight pressures both backline heroes and may spread disease.

dangerousActions.name: Mark Prey
dangerousActions.description: Marks a frontline hero and reduces dodge, enabling allied marked-target attacks.

dangerousActions.name: Rain of Blight
dangerousActions.description: Attacks both backline heroes with blight and a chance of random disease.

effectiveResponses: Eliminate it before the protected Scratchers it supports.
Pull it into the front to force Escape Cloud, reducing its immediate support pressure.
cautions: Escape Cloud blights the front two heroes while moving the Artillery back, so a pull is disruption rather than a permanent shutdown.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Fungal Artillery

priorityReasons: Her mark and accuracy or dodge debuffs set up lethal allied attacks against multiple heroes.
She also inflicts multi-target stress or frontline blight and disease from any position.

dangerousActions.name: Curse of Vulnerability
dangerousActions.description: Damages and marks up to two heroes while reducing accuracy and dodge.

dangerousActions.name: Embrace the Dark
dangerousActions.description: Inflicts stress on up to two heroes and reduces torchlight.

dangerousActions.name: Fetid Censer
dangerousActions.description: From the front, attacks both frontline heroes with stress, blight, and a disease chance.
counters: Do not rely on pulling her forward as a shutdown

effectiveResponses: Prioritize her early and bring destealth or attacks that bypass stealth.
Use accuracy support or dodge reduction to overcome her evasion.
cautions: Unlike many backline supports, moving her forward does not make her harmless.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Crone

priorityReasons: Treebranch Smackdown can deliver extreme burst damage to a frontline hero.
Confusion Spores shuffles the entire party while reducing accuracy.

dangerousActions.name: Treebranch Smackdown
dangerousActions.description: One of the strongest non-boss single-target attacks, striking the frontline and knocking the victim backward.

dangerousActions.name: Confusion Spores
dangerousActions.description: Attacks and shuffles the entire party while reducing accuracy.

dangerousActions.name: Poison Spores
dangerousActions.description: Applies blight to any hero and becomes more likely against a critically wounded target.
counters: Heal heroes away from Death's Door

effectiveResponses: Reduce its damage while removing more fragile support enemies, then focus it safely.
Use bleed and direct damage; do not expect movement control to work reliably.
cautions: Its enormous health pool makes a one-round kill unlikely.
A shuffled position-dependent party may lose both damage and healing access.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Unclean Giant

priorityReasons: From Death Comes Life turns corpses into Necrotic Fungus, preventing all hero healing while the growth remains.
Ruinous Hex marks and severely weakens multiple heroes for allied attacks.

dangerousActions.name: From Death Comes Life

counters: Use attacks that leave no corpse

dangerousActions.name: Ruinous Hex
dangerousActions.description: Damages and marks up to two heroes while heavily reducing accuracy and dodge.

dangerousActions.name: Putrefying Breath
dangerousActions.description: Hits the first three heroes with damage, blight, and knockback.

effectiveResponses: Treat her as an immediate Champion-tier priority while accounting for other lethal attackers.
Use high-accuracy attacks and corpse clearing rather than repeated stun attempts.
cautions: Do not create a corpse without a plan to clear it before her automatic action.
Focusing her can still be dangerous if an Unclean Giant or marked-target attacker remains uncontrolled.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Hateful Virago

priorityReasons: It deals high direct damage for a common enemy and can pressure either half of the party.
Groups of several Groupers can rapidly overwhelm healing capacity.

dangerousActions.name: Seaward Slash
dangerousActions.description: A strong attack used from the front two enemy positions against frontline heroes.

dangerousActions.name: Spearfishing
dangerousActions.description: Attacks backline heroes from the rear and pulls the target forward at higher difficulty.
counters: Move the Grouper to a less useful position

effectiveResponses: Prioritize Groupers when party health is the immediate constraint.
Use blight, stun, or debuffs against their generally low non-bleed resistances.
cautions: Moving a Grouper changes its targets but does not remove its high damage output.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Pelagic Grouper

priorityReasons: Stress Wave can stress two heroes at once.
Call of the Deep and Sea Breeze increase allied damage output and undo progress through buffs and healing.
traits: Stealth at Veteran and Champion difficulty

dangerousActions.name: Stress Wave
dangerousActions.description: Inflicts substantial stress on one hero with a chance to hit a second target.

dangerousActions.name: Call of the Deep
dangerousActions.description: Buffs another enemy's accuracy, critical chance, and damage.

dangerousActions.name: Sea Breeze
dangerousActions.description: Heals the lowest-health ally other than the Shaman.

effectiveResponses: Prioritize it when stress is the party's main expedition risk.
Pull it into enemy position 1 to force the weak Ceremonial Cut.
cautions: Veteran and Champion variants begin stealthed, requiring destealth, area attacks, or temporary control of their allies.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Pelagic Shaman

priorityReasons: Barnacle Barrier redirects attacks from a more dangerous ally while increasing the Guardian's protection.
Its own damage is modest, so its urgency depends on which enemy it guards.

dangerousActions.name: Barnacle Barrier
dangerousActions.description: Guards an ally and further increases the Guardian's protection.

dangerousActions.name: Octocestus
dangerousActions.description: A modest frontline attack that inflicts bleed.

effectiveResponses: Break or disable its guard before attacking a protected priority target.
Use blight or armor piercing instead of grinding through stacked protection.
cautions: Its priority becomes critical when it guards a Drowned Thrall approaching The Revenge.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Pelagic Guardian

priorityReasons: Its extremely low speed and poor accuracy usually make it less urgent than Cove damage and stress dealers.
Very high protection makes ordinary direct attacks inefficient despite its tiny health pool.

dangerousActions.name: Brine
dangerousActions.description: A low-accuracy attack that may spread disease and sharply reduces dodge and speed.

effectiveResponses: Leave it until urgent enemies are controlled unless its debuff would expose a vulnerable hero.
Use blight, armor piercing, or protection reduction to bypass its armor.
cautions: Low priority does not mean harmless when a disease or dodge debuff would compound other threats.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Sea Maggot

priorityReasons: Shocker combines stun with reduced bleed resistance and may spread disease.
Its broad targeting and speed let it set up Salty Gouge or allied bleed attacks against any hero.

dangerousActions.name: Shocker
dangerousActions.description: Stuns any hero, may spread disease, and reduces bleed resistance.

dangerousActions.name: Salty Gouge
dangerousActions.description: Inflicts bleed, may spread disease, and reduces dodge on any hero.

effectiveResponses: Remove it early before Shocker enables repeated bleed pressure.
Use blight, direct damage, debuffs, or movement rather than relying on stun.
cautions: It can use both skills from any enemy position, so movement disrupts formation but does not fully disable it.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Deep Stinger

priorityReasons: The Revenge deals massive health and stress damage to the entire party on the Thrall's second action.
Its explosion can cause a party wipe and is dangerous from every enemy position.

dangerousActions.name: Gargling Grab
dangerousActions.description: The Thrall's first action damages and stresses a frontline hero, signaling that The Revenge follows on its next action.
counters: Kill the Thrall before its next turn

dangerousActions.name: The Revenge
dangerousActions.description: The Thrall self-destructs, dealing severe damage and stress to the entire party.
counters: Break a Guardian's protection of it

effectiveResponses: Treat it as the default first target regardless of party health or stress.
If it is guarded, break or stun the Guardian and keep the Thrall controlled until it can be killed.
cautions: Moving it does not prevent The Revenge.
Higher-tier stun resistance makes repeated delay less reliable than killing it.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Drowned Thrall

priorityReasons: Arterial Pinch inflicts extreme bleed while reducing healing received.
Tidal Slam can stun and knock a frontline hero three positions backward.

dangerousActions.name: Arterial Pinch
dangerousActions.description: Applies catastrophic bleed and reduces healing received, with the effect able to stack.

dangerousActions.name: Tidal Slam
dangerousActions.description: Damages and stuns a frontline hero while knocking the target to the back.

effectiveResponses: Use blight to bypass its protection and apply protection reduction when available.
Control it while curing Arterial Pinch rather than allowing the bleed to tick or stack.
cautions: Its high stun resistance makes control useful but unreliable.
A position-dependent frontline can lose several turns after Tidal Slam.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Uca Major

priorityReasons: Offkilter Jig inflicts heavy stress and horror on the entire party.
Maddening Shanty adds a stress-received debuff that lasts until camp, increasing expedition-wide risk.

dangerousActions.name: Maddening Shanty
dangerousActions.description: Stresses one hero, increases stress received until camp, and moves the Ghast to the front; it always targets a Jester if present.
counters: Move it away from the front before its follow-up

dangerousActions.name: Offkilter Jig
dangerousActions.description: From the front, inflicts stress and horror on the entire party before moving the Ghast back.
counters: Move it out of the front

effectiveResponses: Treat it as an immediate Champion-tier priority and use high-accuracy attacks.
Exploit its moderate move resistance to interrupt the front-to-back attack cycle when possible.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Squiffy Ghast

priorityReasons: Rend for the Old Gods inflicts bleed and increases stress received.
It deals increased damage to heroes marked by a Cultist Acolyte.

dangerousActions.name: Rend for the Old Gods
dangerousActions.description: A frontline attack that bleeds, increases stress received, and deals increased damage to marked heroes.

effectiveResponses: Remove its supporting Acolyte first when stress and marks are the larger threat.
Push it to the rear to force the weak Stumbling Scratch.
cautions: Its priority rises when a vulnerable frontline hero is marked.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Cultist Brawler

priorityReasons: Stressful Incantation creates persistent expedition risk and later marks targets for Brawlers.
Pull and push attacks disrupt party formation while adding stress at higher difficulty.

dangerousActions.name: Stressful Incantation
dangerousActions.description: Inflicts heavy stress, reduces torchlight, and marks its target at Veteran and Champion difficulty.

dangerousActions.name: Eldritch Pull / Eldritch Push
dangerousActions.description: Moves a backline hero forward or a frontline hero backward, adding stress at higher difficulty.

effectiveResponses: Prioritize it before the Brawler it supports.
Use high-accuracy backline damage or stun.
cautions: Moving it forward does not disable its stress or push abilities because they remain usable from the front.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Cultist Acolyte

priorityReasons: Its attacks have high critical potential and reach broadly.
Slice and Dice reduces bleed resistance before Shank and Bloodletter attacks exploit it.

dangerousActions.name: Slice and Dice
dangerousActions.description: Hits both frontline heroes and reduces bleed resistance.

dangerousActions.name: Shank
dangerousActions.description: A high-damage bleed attack with broad targeting and a preference for exposed or marked heroes.

effectiveResponses: Kill it before the tougher Bloodletter when its damage is not otherwise controlled.
Push it to position 4 to force Harmless Poke.
cautions: Its bleed-resistance debuff also increases the threat of a paired Bloodletter.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Brigand Cutthroat

priorityReasons: Blanket Fire damages the entire party and repeatedly reduces dodge.
Its speed and backline position let the debuff accumulate while allies exploit reduced evasion.

dangerousActions.name: Blanket Fire
dangerousActions.description: Attacks all four heroes and reduces dodge.

effectiveResponses: Pull it to the front to force the weak Rushed Shot while exposing other brigands.
Use area riposte to punish its party-wide attack.
cautions: Veteran and Champion variants begin stealthed.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Brigand Fusilier

priorityReasons: Rain of Whips applies bleed and stress across the party.
Its large health pool often makes removing its fragile allies first more efficient.

dangerousActions.name: Rain of Whips
dangerousActions.description: Attacks the whole party with bleed and stress.
counters: Eliminate the Cutthroat that encourages this attack

dangerousActions.name: Point Blank Shot
dangerousActions.description: A high-critical frontline shot that knocks the first hero backward.
counters: Keep another enemy or corpse in front of it
Move the Bloodletter away from position 1

effectiveResponses: Remove fragile Cutthroats and Fusiliers first when Point Blank Shot is contained.
Use damage-over-time and debuffs while reducing its action value.
cautions: Its priority rises sharply when it occupies enemy position 1 against an exposed hero.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Brigand Bloodletter

priorityReasons: This Champion-tier Cutthroat variant combines high damage, bleed, and protection.
Its Shank can mark a hero and create dangerous regional synergies.

dangerousActions.name: Shank
dangerousActions.description: Deals heavy damage and bleed and can mark its target for allied follow-up attacks.

effectiveResponses: Treat it as a priority Champion attacker.
Use high accuracy and armor piercing, or push it to the rear.
cautions: A mark can enable region-specific threats such as Rabid Gnashers even when no other brigand uses it.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Brigand Raider

priorityReasons: Its improved Blanket Fire deals party-wide damage, stress, and a dodge debuff.
High speed and starting stealth make it difficult to prevent the first attack.

dangerousActions.name: Blanket Fire
dangerousActions.description: Attacks every hero, adds stress, and reduces dodge.

effectiveResponses: Prioritize it before durable brigands.
Pulling it forward forces the weaker Rushed Shot.
cautions: Without destealth, plan to control its allies until the Hunter becomes targetable.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Brigand Hunter

priorityReasons: Doomsay applies stress across the entire party.
Accusation applies horror and a stacking stress-received debuff that lasts until camp.

dangerousActions.name: Doomsay
dangerousActions.description: Attempts to stress every hero at once.

dangerousActions.name: Accusation
dangerousActions.description: Applies horror and increases stress received until the next camp, with a bias toward already-stressed heroes.

effectiveResponses: Treat it as an immediate priority in nearly every formation.
Use accuracy support or dodge reduction to secure the kill.
cautions: Its attacks work from every enemy position, so movement alone does not disable it.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Madman

priorityReasons: Grave Nibble can stun, stress, and spread disease despite low direct damage.
Its very low health makes removing this persistent risk inexpensive.

dangerousActions.name: Grave Nibble
dangerousActions.description: A low-accuracy attack against any hero that can stun, stress, and inflict a random disease.

effectiveResponses: Kill it with direct damage rather than trying to stun it.
Its death leaves no corpse, making cleanup straightforward.
cautions: A pack left alive can generate several stun or disease attempts despite each Maggot's weak damage.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Maggot

priorityReasons: Web stuns and marks a hero while reducing blight resistance.
The mark lets both Webbers and paired Spitters deal double damage.
traits: Does not normally appear in Cove

dangerousActions.name: Web
dangerousActions.description: Stuns and marks any hero while reducing blight resistance.

dangerousActions.name: Bite
dangerousActions.description: Blights its target and deals double damage against marked heroes.

effectiveResponses: Kill Webbers before Spitters to prevent the mark setup.
Use accuracy support against their dodge.
cautions: Every enemy and hero position is valid for both actions, so movement does not disable it.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Webber

priorityReasons: Spit deals double damage to marked heroes while applying blight and an accuracy debuff.
Its high dodge and backline position can make a marked-target burst difficult to prevent.
traits: Does not normally appear in Cove

dangerousActions.name: Spit
dangerousActions.description: A high-critical ranged attack that doubles damage against marked heroes and applies blight and reduced accuracy.

effectiveResponses: Remove Webbers first when they can create a mark, then kill or pull the Spitter.
Use high accuracy against its dodge.
cautions: Pulling it forward replaces Spit with Bite, but Bite still blights and deals double damage to marked heroes.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Spitter

priorityReasons: It is slow, fragile, and inaccurate with little direct threat.
Its main value is occupying space and leaving a corpse that screens more urgent enemies.
traits: Common in Ruins and uncommon elsewhere

dangerousActions.name: Bump in the Night
dangerousActions.description: A weak frontline attack that reduces dodge at higher difficulty.
counters: Leave it until urgent enemies are controlled

effectiveResponses: Attack the higher-priority enemies it screens when possible.
Use blight or direct damage rather than bleed.
cautions: Its corpse may continue blocking access to the backline after the Rabble dies.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Bone Rabble

priorityReasons: Howl applies party-wide horror, reduces torchlight, and may inflict The Worries.
Skull Toss combines backline damage, stress, and stun while its durability delays removal.

dangerousActions.name: Howl
dangerousActions.description: Applies horror across the party, reduces torchlight, and may inflict The Worries.

dangerousActions.name: Skull Toss
dangerousActions.description: Hits a backline hero with significant damage, stress, and stun.

dangerousActions.name: Rend
dangerousActions.description: A heavy frontline bleed attack that increases stress received.
counters: Move frontline heroes out of reach

effectiveResponses: Use bleed, blight, armor piercing, or protection reduction to work through its defenses.
A strong stun setup may buy one turn, but sustained control is unreliable.
cautions: Unlike most Unholy enemies, the Ghoul is a practical bleed target.
It can threaten the backline from every enemy position.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Ghoul

priorityReasons: Its damage is low and its main threat is occasional stun or movement disruption.
High protection makes ordinary direct attacks inefficient relative to more urgent enemies.
traits: Very high bleed and move resistance
Common in Ruins and rare elsewhere

dangerousActions.name: Lash of the Tail
dangerousActions.description: Targets any hero with a stun and later knockback, with increased preference for marked targets.

dangerousActions.name: Flurry of Claws
dangerousActions.description: A low-damage frontline attack that can shuffle its targets at higher difficulty.
counters: Leave it until higher priorities are handled

effectiveResponses: Use blight or armor piercing to bypass protection.
Stun it while dealing with more dangerous enemies.
cautions: Do not waste bleed or movement actions against its extreme resistances.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Gargoyle
